title: Conditional predictive information in worm neural history
disposition_reason: A causal-history helper and independent matched-probability scorer exist. They do not execute native conversion or model fitting, and scorer receipts cannot establish that supplied predictions used causal features or isolated whole-worm training.

scientific_target.question: Across entirely held-out worms, does adding neural history reduce post-reversal direction log loss beyond the same recent curvature, velocity and odor context, and beyond a displaced-neural diagnostic?
scientific_target.known_answer: The independently recomputed equal-worm difference between behavior-only and behavior-plus-neural held-out Bernoulli log losses; null or negative increments are valid answers. Labels are dorsal=1 and ventral=0.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source-grounded post-reversal direction labels and separately frozen matched predictions; final native event/window selection, complete H5/MAT-to-episode mapping and physical-time support remain unresolved.
scientific_target.case_unit: A frozen observation within a complete odor/reversal episode with cutoff and strictly later target interval; multiple windows remain nested observations.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Biological worm, stable across sessions and duplicate source representations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional predictive association under a declared causal observation history and identical whole-worm folds; no causal mechanism inference or reward for a positive narrative.
exclusions: No reproduction of author event-fold balanced accuracy or class-binomial uncertainty.
No proof of causal preprocessing/fitting from a submitted hash receipt.
No standalone direct-understanding result from correctly recomputing an aggregate loss contrast.

inputs: Behavioral histories of curvature, velocity and odor encounters plus measured neural channels, each with exact physical timestamp, support_end_ns and available_ns.
Identical frozen lags, query cutoff and allowed behavior context for all arms; shifted neural history uses an exact positive no-wrap lag beyond the full history span.
Permitted training/validation-worm labels for the selected frozen recipe; query targets reside only in operator reference.
forbidden_inputs: Future behavior, query dorsal labels/target intervals, warped features using future curvature, cross-session shifted samples or held-worm training.
Treating nominal aligned frame indices as physical nanoseconds or using future-inclusive smoothing without declaring support.
observation_contract.case_identity: Explicit unique observation ID plus worm_id/session_id/episode_id/fold_id; duplicate physical worm/session/cutoff is rejected. source_manifest_sha256 binds a declared complete inventory but does not authenticate source identity.
observation_contract.split: Declared whole-worm folds partition the complete selected population; each evaluation worm is tested exactly once and all its scored episodes remain intact. Exact native IDs and final split manifest are not yet established.
observation_contract.coverage: The evaluator requires every observation in every frozen scored episode and exactly the same row set across behavior, neural_history and shifted_neural_history. It cannot verify that the declared native population is complete.

primary.name: Equal-worm mean behavior-minus-neural log loss, nats
primary.aggregation: Mean Bernoulli loss equally across observations within a worm, then equal mean of paired worm contrasts.
primary.rationale: Tests incremental prediction beyond the same behavioral information without weighting worms by episode count or rewarding agreement with the source conclusion. This is a descriptive signed investigation estimand, not an unrestricted contestant reward: all three supplied arms can be manipulated. A separate independently frozen competent behavior-only reference is required before rewarding neural improvement.

secondary: Absolute equal-worm neural-history and behavior-only log losses must accompany every contrast; deliberately worsening a submitted baseline cannot establish neural understanding.
Behavior-minus-shifted and shifted-minus-neural loss contrasts on identical rows.
All per-worm arm losses, constant-probability diagnostics, complete episode coverage and descriptive paired intervals.
A separately prospective absolute direction balanced-accuracy companion may be reported with a frozen threshold; it is not implemented as this scorer primary.

comparators.name: Behavior-only fixed decoder
comparators.inputs: Only permitted causal curvature, velocity and odor history.
comparators.procedure: Prospectively freeze one competent regularized direction decoder and train-only selection shared across neural-added arms; actual fitting is not supplied by the scorer. The evaluator currently accepts participant-supplied behavior probabilities; comparative reward remains unavailable until the competent baseline predictions and their source are independently frozen.

comparators.name: Time-displaced neural diagnostic
comparators.inputs: Exactly the same behavior plus positively time-shifted neural history from the same worm/session.
comparators.procedure: The helper enforces exact shift, support and availability; refit the same declared decoder with no target feedback. The scored receipt does not execute this procedure.

nuisance_controls: Exact source support/availability for smoothing, warping and normalization; future-derived event alignment is prohibited.
No-wrap within-session neural displacement, matched behavior and matched complete observations; stationarity/exchangeability still require source assessment.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired whole-worm 95% percentile intervals: enumerate ordered size-N resamples for two to five worms; 10,000 seed-1729 resamples above five; one worm has no interval. Descriptive development uncertainty does not solve small-N calibration or overlapping model-training dependence.
evaluation.failure_policy: Exact IDs and three-arm coverage are mandatory; malformed, duplicate, missing or label-bearing rows fail. Probabilities must lie strictly inside (0,1), with no silent clipping; constants are scored and diagnosed. Incomplete causal support rejects the complete history request rather than dropping cases.

implementation.scorer_target: evaluator.score recomputes known-label matched Bernoulli prediction contrasts and whole-worm uncertainty. causal_histories is a separate feature builder; the scoring CLI does not call it or fit models.
implementation.delivered_scope: Standard-library probability scorer and exact-clock history helper with generated numerical and adversarial tests. This is substantive conditional-prediction evaluation, not author-table reproduction, but source-to-model execution remains absent.
missing: Native H5/MAT conversion retaining animal and episode identities, physical causal support and odor alignment.
Frozen authentic population, endpoints/windows, competent matched decoder fitting and independently audited execution.
Participant per-case investigator transport and direct/viewer case protocols.
Independent frozen competent behavior-only baseline before using a larger submitted loss contrast as a benchmark reward.
implementation.execution_evidence: Existing generated tests cover loss/uncertainty oracles, unequal worm sizes, arm swaps/nulls, coverage, clocks and future support. Existing provenance states no authentic reference/model run; no new execution is claimed.

direct_observation.representation: The scored target is an across-worm predictive-information contrast requiring matched trained predictions.
direct_observation.boundary: A no-tools reading of a trace cannot estimate this held-out incremental loss; reading a precomputed loss table would be a different arithmetic task.
missing: A separate direction-decoding direct task would need an explicitly separate condition and endpoint.

typed_viewer.representation: A future trace viewer may support investigation of history/controls; it does not itself deliver the full predictive contrast.
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed actions must preserve the causal cutoff and hide query targets; all numeric claims still require independent scoring.
missing: No task-specific viewer, matched rendering protocol or participant transport.

tool_assisted.representation: Causal history and loss/interval routines can support numerical investigation of matched predictions.
tool_assisted.boundary: Operator reference is private; participant model fitting, feature lineage and all case-local tools must be independently bound and audited.
missing: No supplied native fitting/investigator runner or isolation evidence.
Operator analysis/comparator source does not supply a participant episode or candidate programme execution route.

frozen_program.representation: Intended precommitted decoder/training recipe producing the three complete matched arms.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze recipe and budgets before query access; only training-worm labels may fit transforms or select hyperparameters.
missing: Current CLI grades prediction artifacts; it does not execute a candidate or attest its fitting.

evidence.supports: Preserved original scientific question, source identity and proposed endpoint.
Exact-clock causal-history helper, separate matched-probability scorer and whole-worm log-loss policy.
Native source mapping, prospective decisions and distinction between declared receipts and actual fitting.
Exact primary code pins and existing source review; no native execution.
Direction labels and scientific source; phase-warping cautions are documented in local source review.
Aligned SAAV+curvature versus zero+curvature author comparisons, with event-level folds distinct from the revised biological-unit target.
Inspected generated numerical and malformed-input controls; generated fixtures are not authentic model results.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing generated engineering tests only; no native model result or direct/viewer study for this registration is established.
excluded_claims: No reproduction of author event-fold balanced accuracy or class-binomial uncertainty.
No proof of causal preprocessing/fitting from a submitted hash receipt.
No standalone direct-understanding result from correctly recomputing an aggregate loss contrast.

summary: Make conditional held-worm predictive information the known-answer target rather than agreement with a claimed neural effect.
Separate numeric scorer validity from causal history construction and actual matched fitting; a source hash does not establish those operations.
Mark standalone direct interpretation unsuitable for this aggregate estimand without changing the task.
Make the loss contrast two-sided descriptive evidence; prevent degraded participant baselines from masquerading as improved neural understanding.
Reserve participant access capability for an actual actor route; operator numerical/comparator routines remain documented implementation components.
revision.source_review: Inspected original registration, implementation scientific contract, numerical/preparation source and existing primary-source provenance. Reused explicitly pinned primary evidence; no native data acquisition or model run.
